journeys.title: Standalone stock and coax geometry
journeys.expect: Create stock without endpoints; reconcile independently known section dimensions, table identities, layered preview and unknown ratings.

journeys.title: Cable review, documents and a changed termination
journeys.expect: Review/freeze a cable, produce coordinated output, record one synthetic unit result, change termination and show affected evidence without rewriting history.

journeys.title: Preserved board import and real-tool output
journeys.expect: A licensed synthetic native-board source survives intake, review, supported authoring/checks and real fabrication output.

journeys.title: Repeated boards in a shared device
journeys.expect: Two board occurrences retain separate location, port mapping and firmware through all views and portable subassembly export.

journeys.title: Make/buy, stock and measured unit
journeys.expect: Reserve stock, build partially, record actual use/returns and unit-scoped evidence while optional costs remain absent.

journeys.title: Explicit reuse and impact
journeys.expect: Adopt a selected replacement after impact review; existing releases and observations retain their exact historical basis.

journeys.title: Scoped external agent workflow
journeys.expect: Discover schemas, perform bounded draft work, request authorized build, inspect results and prepare review; deny ungranted side effects.

journeys.title: Lost receipt, cancellation and runner fencing
journeys.expect: Interrupt actual native execution and recover without duplicate logical attempts, false cancellation or acceptance from stale leases.

journeys.title: Access/export/public-source boundary
journeys.expect: Reject private traversal/export leaks including hidden closure; published code/examples contain no confidential operator material.

journeys.title: Fresh startup, idle and same-version restore
journeys.expect: Install without external dependencies, initialize within existing services, run a real job, measure idle and restore records plus bytes.

journeys.title: Later process preparation and measured outcome
journeys.expect: Prepare a supported manufacturing variant, record actual post-processing/test results and keep printer control separately authorized.
